At grading time test.sh:3 umask 077, :11 chmod 700 on the log dir, :12 chmod -R go-rwx /tests, :72-83 zero reward on any symlink escaping /app/node_modules, :104-111 app launched with env -i (no judge token) under setpriv uid/gid 65534, so the submitted server cannot read /tests, read the key from its environment, or write reward.json. Leak scans: 0 of 54 criterion ids appear in instruction.md or environment/; 0 of 54 criterion descriptions share an 80-character normalized run with the public instructions; 0 keyword hits for rewardkit/judge/rubric/criteri/reward/verifier//tests//logs/openrouter/anthropic in instruction.md, environment/instructions or seed_data.json. test.sh, both Dockerfiles, .dockerignore, score.py, restart_mcp.py and scoring.toml are byte-identical (modulo CR) to the frozen template; task.toml differs only in identity/metadata lines 5-15. Tried break: a submission whose server.js reads /tests/scored/functional/judge.toml or overwrites /logs/verifier/reward.json at startup is blocked by uid 65534 against mode go-rwx / 700 root-owned paths; a submission symlinking /app/x to /tests exits at test.sh:81 with the zero reward. Conforming alternative: an app with ordinary internal node_modules symlinks is allowed by test.sh:74-78. Limits: this is source inspection only; the permission behaviour was not executed in the verifier image on these bytes (the index's golden run used the agent image, and the hosted Oracle 0.9833 / nop 0 run was an earlier candidate).
